description:
You are a GIS Technologist setting up a multi-department GeoServer deployment. The Natural Earth data team needs their own isolated WFS (Web Feature Service) endpoint with controlled feature download limits.

Configure workspace-specific WFS service settings for the 'ne' workspace with the following parameters:
- Title: Natural Earth Feature Service
- Abstract: Provides controlled access to Natural Earth vector datasets
- Max Features: 50
- Service Level: COMPLETE
- Enabled: true

IMPORTANT: These must be workspace-specific WFS settings (not global WFS settings). In GeoServer, workspace-specific settings can be configured via the REST API or through the web admin interface under the workspace's Services configuration.

After configuring the settings, perform the following verification steps:

1. Save the workspace-specific WFS GetCapabilities response to ~/ne_wfs_capabilities.xml by requesting:
   http://localhost:8080/geoserver/ne/wfs?service=WFS&request=GetCapabilities

2. Save a WFS GetFeature response for ne_countries to ~/ne_countries_features.json by requesting:
   http://localhost:8080/geoserver/ne/wfs?service=WFS&version=1.1.0&request=GetFeature&typeName=ne_countries&outputFormat=application/json

The GetFeature response should contain at most 50 features due to the configured limit.

GeoServer credentials: admin / Admin123!
GeoServer URL: http://localhost:8080/geoserver

metadata.expected_abstract: Provides controlled access to Natural Earth vector datasets
